query:
SELECT 
  'Total' as category,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM investments
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Multi-country (MULTI)' as category,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM investments
WHERE target_country_code = 'MULTI'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Single country' as category,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM investments
WHERE target_country_code != 'MULTI' OR target_country_code IS NULL;
